title: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: A creamy, authentic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, and pancetta.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions.
In a skillet, cook pancetta until crispy. Remove from heat.
In a bowl, whisk eggs, cheeses, and black pepper.
Drain pasta, reserving some water. Add hot pasta to skillet with pancetta.
Quickly mix in egg mixture off heat, adding pasta water if needed for creaminess.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and pepper.

title: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
description: A fresh, healthy salad with quinoa, feta, olives, and tomatoes.
instructions: Rinse quinoa and cook in water until fluffy, about 15 minutes. Let cool.
In a large bowl, combine cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta.
Add cooled quinoa to the bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper for dressing.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently.
Garnish with parsley and serve chilled.

title: Homemade Margherita Pizza
description: A simple yet delicious pizza with fresh basil, mozzarella, and tomatoes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C).
Roll out pizza dough on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly, leaving a border.
Add mozzarella slices and tomato slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden.
Top with fresh basil before serving.

title: Blueberry Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes bursting with fresh blueberries, perfect for breakfast.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
In another bowl, mix buttermilk, egg, and melted butter.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed. Fold in blueberries.
Heat a skillet over medium heat. Pour batter for each pancake.
Cook until bubbles form and edges look set, then flip.
Cook until golden. Serve with maple syrup.

title: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: A decadent dessert with a gooey chocolate center, served with ice cream.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Grease ramekins.
Melt chocolate and butter together.
Whisk eggs, yolks, and sugar until pale.
Fold in chocolate mixture and flour.
Pour into ramekins and bake for 12-14 minutes.
Let cool slightly, then invert onto plates.
Serve with ice cream.

title: Grilled Chicken Wrap
description: A healthy wrap with grilled chicken, avocado, and fresh veggies.
ingredients: Greek yogurt or mayo for spread
instructions: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and olive oil. Grill until cooked.
Slice grilled chicken.
Spread yogurt on tortillas.
Layer chicken, avocado, tomato, onion, and lettuce.
Roll up tightly and cut in half.
Serve immediately.

title: Avocado Toast
description: Simple and nutritious breakfast with creamy avocado on toasted bread.
instructions: Toast bread until golden.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread on toast.
Top with tomatoes and red pepper flakes if desired.
Serve immediately.

title: Caesar Salad
description: Classic salad with romaine, croutons, Parmesan, and Caesar dressing.
instructions: Chop lettuce and place in bowl.
Add croutons and Parmesan.
Drizzle with dressing and olive oil.
Toss gently.
Serve with lemon wedge.

title: French Toast
description: Sweet and crispy breakfast treat dipped in egg and cinnamon.
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon, vanilla.
Dip bread in mixture.
Fry in butter until golden on both sides.
Serve with syrup.

title: Caprese Salad
description: Fresh Italian salad with tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil.
instructions: Arrange tomato and mozzarella slices alternately.
Top with basil.
Drizzle with oil and vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve chilled.

title: Chicken Parmesan
description: Breaded chicken cutlets topped with marinara and cheese.
instructions: Pound chicken thin, bread with flour, egg, breadcrumbs.
Fry until golden.
Top with sauce and cheeses.
Bake at 400°F for 10 minutes.
Serve with pasta.

title: Tiramisu
description: Classic Italian dessert with coffee-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone.
instructions: Dip ladyfingers in coffee.
Layer in dish.
Mix mascarpone, eggs, sugar for cream.
Spread over ladyfingers.
Repeat layers.
Dust with cocoa. Chill overnight.

title: Fruit Salad
description: Refreshing mix of seasonal fruits with a honey dressing.
instructions: Combine fruits in bowl.
Mix honey and lemon for dressing.
Pour over fruits.
Toss gently.
Garnish with mint.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: Quick and healthy stir-fry with mixed vegetables and tofu.
instructions: Heat oil in wok, fry tofu until golden.
Add garlic and ginger, stir.
Add vegetables, stir-fry until tender.
Add soy sauce, cook for 2 minutes.
Serve over rice.

title: Omelette
description: Fluffy omelette with cheese and herbs.
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in pan.
Pour eggs, cook until set.
Add cheese and herbs.
Fold and serve.

title: Turkey Sandwich
description: Classic sandwich with turkey, lettuce, and tomato.
instructions: Spread mayo on bread.
Layer turkey, lettuce, tomato.
Season with salt and pepper.
Top with second slice.
Cut and serve.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Chewy cookies loaded with chocolate chips.
instructions: Cream butter and sugars.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Mix flour and baking soda.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Drop on baking sheet.
Bake at 350°F for 10-12 minutes.

title: Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick smoothie topped with fruits and nuts.
instructions: Blend banana, berries, yogurt, milk.
Pour into bowl.
Top with granola and fruits.
Serve immediately.

title: Greek Salad
description: Fresh salad with feta, olives, and cucumber.
instructions: Combine vegetables in bowl.
Add feta and olives.
Drizzle with dressing.
Toss and serve.

title: Cheesecake
description: Creamy cheesecake with graham cracker crust.
instructions: Beat cream cheese and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Pour over crust.
Bake at 325°F for 50 minutes.
Top with berries.

title: Veggie Omelette
description: Fluffy omelette loaded with fresh vegetables.
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in pan, sauté veggies.
Pour eggs over veggies.
Cook until set, fold and serve.

title: Bacon and Egg Sandwich
description: Classic breakfast sandwich with crispy bacon.
instructions: Cook bacon until crispy.
Fry eggs.
Toast bread with butter.
Layer bacon, egg, cheese.
Serve as sandwich.

title: Chia Seed Pudding
description: Healthy pudding made with chia seeds and almond milk.
instructions: Mix chia, milk, honey, vanilla.
Refrigerate overnight.
Stir and top with fruits.

title: Sausage Breakfast Burrito
description: Hearty burrito with sausage, eggs, and cheese.
instructions: Scramble eggs.
Layer in tortilla: sausage, eggs, cheese.
Roll up, serve with salsa.

title: Overnight Oats
description: Easy no-cook oats prepared the night before.
instructions: Mix all ingredients.
Refrigerate overnight.
Stir and enjoy.

title: Smoked Salmon Bagel
description: Bagel topped with smoked salmon and cream cheese.
instructions: Toast bagel.
Spread cream cheese.
Top with salmon, capers, onion.

title: Fruit Parfait
description: Layered yogurt parfait with fruits and granola.
instructions: Layer yogurt, berries, granola.
Drizzle honey.
Serve chilled.

title: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
description: Nutritious bowl with quinoa, veggies, and tahini dressing.
instructions: Cook quinoa.
Arrange veggies on top.
Drizzle dressing.
Serve.

title: Tuna Salad Sandwich
description: Classic tuna salad in a sandwich.
instructions: Mix tuna, mayo, celery.
Spread on bread.
Add lettuce, close sandwich.

title: Lentil Soup
description: Hearty soup made with lentils and vegetables.
instructions: Sauté veggies.
Add lentils and broth.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Blend if desired.

title: Chicken Caesar Wrap
description: Wrap with grilled chicken and Caesar dressing.
instructions: Layer chicken, lettuce in tortilla.
Add dressing and cheese.
Roll up.

title: Chickpea Salad
description: Fresh salad with chickpeas and veggies.
instructions: Mix all ingredients.
Drizzle dressing.
Toss and serve.

title: BLT Sandwich
description: Bacon, lettuce, and tomato sandwich.
instructions: Cook bacon.
Spread mayo on bread.
Layer bacon, lettuce, tomato.

title: Vegetable Sushi Rolls
description: Homemade sushi rolls with fresh vegetables.
instructions: Spread rice on nori.
Add veggies.
Roll tightly, slice.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
description: Baked eggplant with marinara and cheese.
instructions: Bread eggplant slices.
Fry or bake.
Top with sauce and cheese.
Bake until melted.

title: Grilled Salmon
description: Simple grilled salmon with lemon and herbs.
instructions: Season salmon.
Grill 4-5 minutes per side.
Serve with lemon.

title: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy risotto with mushrooms and Parmesan.
instructions: Sauté mushrooms, onion.
Add rice, broth gradually.
Stir until creamy.
Add cheese.

title: Vegetable Curry
description: Spicy curry with mixed vegetables.
instructions: Sauté veggies.
Add curry paste and milk.
Simmer until tender.
Serve with rice.

title: Pork Chops with Apples
description: Juicy pork chops with apple sauce.
instructions: Season and cook pork.
Sauté apples with butter.
Serve together.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Bell peppers stuffed with rice and veggies.
instructions: Mix filling.
Stuff peppers.
Bake 30 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
description: Moist bread made with ripe bananas.
instructions: Mash bananas, mix with butter.
Add sugar, egg, vanilla.
Mix dry ingredients, combine.
Bake at 350°F for 60 minutes.

title: Rice Pudding
description: Creamy pudding made with rice and milk.
instructions: Cook rice in milk.
Add sugar, simmer.
Sprinkle cinnamon.

title: Lemon Bars
description: Tangy lemon bars with shortbread crust.
instructions: Mix crust, bake.
Mix filling, pour over.
Bake again.

title: Apple Pie
description: Classic pie with cinnamon apples.
instructions: Mix apples with sugar, cinnamon.
Fill crust, dot with butter.
Top with crust, bake.

title: Coconut Macaroons
description: Chewy cookies made with coconut.
instructions: Mix ingredients.
Drop on sheet.
Bake at 325°F for 20 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie
description: Spiced pie with pumpkin filling.
instructions: Mix filling.
Pour into crust.
Bake at 425°F for 15 min, then 350°F.

title: Vegan Brownie
description: Fudgy brownies without eggs or dairy.
instructions: Mix dry ingredients.
Add wet, stir.
Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes.

title: Paneer Butter Masala
description: A rich and creamy North Indian curry made with paneer, butter, tomatoes, and cream.
instructions: Heat butter in a pan and sauté onions till golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree, turmeric, red chili powder, and salt. Cook until oil separates.
Add paneer cubes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in cream and garam masala, cook for 2 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve with naan or rice.

title: Sambar
description: A traditional South Indian lentil-based stew made with tamarind, vegetables, and spices.
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (drumstick, brinjal, carrot, beans)
instructions: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric and water until soft.
Soak tamarind in warm water and extract the juice.
Cook vegetables in tamarind extract with sambar powder and salt.
Add mashed dal and simmer for 5–10 minutes.
Heat oil, add mustard, red chilies, and curry leaves for tempering.
Pour tempering over sambar and serve hot with rice or idli.

title: Dal Tadka
description: A comforting dish made with lentils tempered with ghee, garlic, and aromatic spices.
instructions: Cook toor dal with turmeric until soft.
Heat ghee, add cumin, garlic, onion, and sauté until golden.
Add tomatoes and cook until mushy.
Mix in cooked dal and salt, simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve with rice or chapati.

title: Potato Curry (Aloo Curry)
description: A spicy and tangy curry made with potatoes and aromatic Indian spices.
instructions: Heat oil, add mustard and cumin seeds until they splutter.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, chili powder, and salt. Cook till mushy.
Add potatoes and garam masala. Mix well and simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve with rice or roti.

title: Ladies Finger Fry (Bhindi Fry)
description: A crispy and flavorful side dish made with ladies finger and spices.
instructions: Wash and cut ladies finger into small pieces.
Heat oil and add mustard seeds until they pop.
Add onions and sauté till soft.
Add bhindi, turmeric, salt, and chili powder.
Cook uncovered until crisp, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot with rice or chapati.

title: Aavakaya Pickle
description: A spicy and tangy traditional Andhra mango pickle made with raw mangoes and mustard powder.
instructions: Dry mango pieces under shade for 1 hour.
Mix mustard, chili, salt, and turmeric in a bowl.
Add mango pieces and mix well.
Pour gingelly oil and stir until evenly coated.
Store in an airtight jar for 3–4 days before use.

title: Plain Rice
description: Simple steamed rice cooked to perfection, ideal for serving with curries and dals.
instructions: Rinse rice 2–3 times until water runs clear.
Add rice, water, and salt to a pot.
Cover and cook on medium heat for 10–12 minutes until soft.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot.

title: Vegetable Pulao
description: A fragrant rice dish cooked with vegetables and mild spices.
instructions: Soak rice for 15 minutes and drain.
Heat ghee and add spices, then onions until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté briefly.
Add vegetables, rice, salt, and water.
Cook covered until rice is soft and fluffy.
Serve with raita or curry.

title: Curd Rice
description: A cooling South Indian rice dish mixed with curd and tempered with mustard and curry leaves.
instructions: Mash cooked rice and mix with curd and salt.
Heat oil, add mustard seeds, chili, and curry leaves.
Pour tempering over curd rice.
Garnish with grated carrot and serve chilled.

title: Vegetable Biryani
description: A delicious and aromatic rice dish made with mixed vegetables and fragrant spices.
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, peas, potato)
instructions: Cook rice till 80% done and set aside.
In a pan, heat ghee and add whole spices.
Add onion, tomato, and ginger-garlic paste.
Add vegetables, curd, biryani masala, and salt. Cook till veggies are tender.
Layer rice and vegetable masala, cover, and cook on low for 10 minutes.
Serve hot with raita.

title: Chapati
description: A soft Indian flatbread made with whole wheat flour, perfect with any curry.
instructions: Mix flour, salt, and water to form a smooth dough.
Rest the dough for 15–20 minutes.
Divide into balls and roll into thin circles.
Cook on a hot tawa on both sides until light brown spots appear.
Brush with ghee and serve hot.

title: Poori
description: A deep-fried Indian bread that puffs up beautifully, served with curries or halwa.
instructions: Combine flour, salt, oil, and water to make a firm dough.
Divide into small balls and roll into small circles.
Heat oil in a pan and fry poori until golden and puffed.
Serve hot with potato curry or halwa.

title: Chana Masala
description: A spicy and tangy chickpea curry popular in North India.
instructions: Pressure cook chickpeas until soft.
Heat oil and sauté cumin and onions until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomato puree, and spices. Cook until oil separates.
Add cooked chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve with rice or chapati.

title: Aloo Gobi
description: A dry curry made with potatoes, cauliflower, and Indian spices.
instructions: Heat oil, add cumin seeds, and sauté onions until soft.
Add potatoes, cauliflower, and spices.
Cook covered on low heat for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Serve hot with roti or rice.

title: Masala Dosa
description: A crispy South Indian crepe filled with spiced potato masala.
instructions: Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Add onion, chili, turmeric, and salt; sauté and mix with mashed potatoes.
Spread dosa batter on a hot tawa and cook until golden.
Place masala in the center, fold, and serve with chutney and sambar.

title: Idli
description: Soft and fluffy steamed rice cakes, a classic South Indian breakfast.
instructions: Soak rice and dal separately for 4–5 hours.
Grind to a smooth batter and ferment overnight.
Add salt and pour batter into greased idli molds.
Steam for 10–12 minutes and serve with chutney or sambar.

title: Lemon Rice
description: A tangy and flavorful South Indian rice dish tempered with lemon juice and spices.
instructions: Heat oil and add mustard, urad dal, chilies, and curry leaves.
Add turmeric and turn off heat.
Mix in rice, salt, and lemon juice.
Stir well and serve with pickle or papad.

title: Tomato Rasam
description: A tangy South Indian soup made with tomatoes, tamarind, and pepper spices.
instructions: Soak tamarind in water and extract juice.
Boil tomatoes with turmeric and tamarind extract.
Add salt, pepper, and cumin powder.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Serve hot with rice.

title: Vegetable Kurma
description: A flavorful curry made with mixed vegetables, coconut, and aromatic spices.
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrot, peas, beans, potato)
instructions: Grind coconut with a little water to make a paste.
Heat oil, sauté onions, ginger-garlic, and tomato.
Add vegetables, salt, and masala; cook until soft.
Add coconut paste and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with chapati or rice.

title: Puliyogare (Tamarind Rice)
description: A South Indian rice dish flavored with tamarind, peanuts, and spices.
instructions: Soak tamarind in water and extract juice.
Heat oil, add mustard, chana dal, peanuts, and curry leaves.
Add tamarind juice and cook until thick.
Mix with rice and serve with papad or curd.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: A quick Indo-Chinese rice dish tossed with vegetables and soy sauce.
ingredients: 1 cup chopped vegetables (carrot, beans, capsicum, cabbage)
instructions: Heat oil in a wok and sauté vegetables on high flame.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Toss in rice and mix well.
Serve hot with chili sauce or manchurian.

title: Aloo Paratha
description: A stuffed Indian flatbread filled with spiced mashed potatoes.
instructions: Prepare dough using wheat flour and water.
Mix potatoes with spices for stuffing.
Roll dough, place filling, and seal edges.
Cook on tawa with ghee until golden brown on both sides.
Serve with curd or pickle.

title: Vegetable Upma
description: A South Indian breakfast made with roasted semolina and vegetables.
instructions: Roast semolina until golden and set aside.
Heat oil, add mustard, urad dal, onions, curry leaves, and carrot.
Add water and salt, bring to boil.
Add semolina gradually while stirring.
Cook until thick and serve hot.

title: Vegetable Pakora
description: Crispy deep-fried fritters made with mixed vegetables and gram flour batter.
instructions: Mix all ingredients into a thick batter.
Heat oil and drop spoonfuls of batter.
Fry until golden and crisp.
Serve hot with chutney or sauce.

title: Cabbage Curry
description: A simple and healthy dry curry made with cabbage and spices.
instructions: Heat oil, add mustard seeds and onions.
Add cabbage, turmeric, and salt.
Cook covered for 10 minutes until soft.
Add chili powder, mix well, and serve.

title: Vegetable Khichdi
description: A comforting one-pot meal of rice and lentils cooked with vegetables and spices.
instructions: Wash rice and dal together.
Heat oil, add cumin, turmeric, and vegetables.
Add rice, dal, salt, and water.
Pressure cook for 3 whistles.
Serve hot with ghee or pickle.

title: Methi Thepla
description: Gujarati flatbread made with fenugreek leaves, wheat flour, and spices.
instructions: Mix all ingredients into a soft dough.
Roll into thin circles.
Cook on tawa with a little oil until golden on both sides.
Serve with curd or pickle.

title: Vegetable Sandwich
description: A quick and healthy sandwich with fresh vegetables and butter.
instructions: Spread butter on bread slices.
Arrange cucumber, tomato, and onion slices.
Sprinkle salt and pepper.
Cover with another slice and serve fresh or toasted.

title: Vegetable Manchurian
description: Fried vegetable balls in a spicy Indo-Chinese sauce.
instructions: Mix vegetables, maida, and cornflour to make balls.
Fry till golden and crisp.
In a pan, add sauces, salt, and a little water.
Add fried balls and toss well.
Serve hot with fried rice or noodles.

title: Vegetable Noodles
description: A flavorful Indo-Chinese noodle dish stir-fried with vegetables and soy sauce.
instructions: Boil noodles and drain.
Heat oil, sauté vegetables on high flame.
Add sauces, salt, and pepper.
Toss noodles well and serve hot.

title: Plain Dosa
description: A crispy and golden South Indian crepe made from fermented rice and urad dal batter.
instructions: Soak rice, urad dal, and fenugreek seeds for 6 hours.
Grind into a smooth batter and ferment overnight.
Add salt and mix well.
Heat a dosa tawa, pour a ladle of batter, and spread in circular motion.
Drizzle oil around edges and cook till golden brown.
Serve hot with chutney and sambar.

title: Onion Dosa
description: A flavorful dosa topped with finely chopped onions, green chilies, and coriander.
instructions: Heat a dosa tawa and pour a ladle of batter, spreading evenly.
Sprinkle chopped onion, green chili, and coriander over the dosa.
Drizzle oil on the sides and cook until golden brown.
Fold and serve hot with coconut chutney and sambar.
